mapper.sql: select b.black_id, b.supplier_id, b.black_reason, b.black_date, b.black_until, b.status, b.lift_date, b.lift_by, b.lift_opinion, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark, s.supplier_name as supplier_name from jc_supplier_black b left join jc_supplier s on s.supplier_id = b.supplier_id
mapper.select: where b.supplier_id = #{supplierId} order by b.black_date desc
where b.supplier_id = #{supplierId} and b.status = '0' order by b.black_date desc limit 1
mapper.update: update jc_supplier_black set del_flag = '1', update_by = 'system', update_time = sysdate() where black_id = #{blackId}
mapper.select: where b.del_flag = '0' and b.status = '0' and b.black_until is not null and b.black_until < curdate() order by b.black_until asc

select date_format(black_date, '%Y-%m') as name, count(1) as value from jc_supplier_black where del_flag = '0' and black_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 12 month) group by date_format(black_date, '%Y-%m') order by name
